funding.authority_quote: Customers are unable to place orders.
funding.raw: All checkout requests to `order-service` in the `pets` namespace on cluster `aks-srelab` are timing out due to a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy that blocks **all ingress and egress** traffic to/from the order-service pods.

admission.agent_reason: This is an OWNER-authored (author_association: OWNER, login jorgedvp) incident report announcing a live production outage: customer checkout is fully blocked because a NetworkPolicy denies all ingress/egress to the order-service pods. It is unpriced, so it is recorded as a founder-wound lead with no monetary claim. The report is bounded and actionable - it names the offending object (deny-order-service), the namespace, the failure mode (POST to order-service:3000 times out, egress to rabbitmq:5672 blocked) and includes the manifest and an impact table. The cited product file is the order-service application source whose HTTP endpoint the outage blocks.
admission.scope_quote: A NetworkPolicy named **`deny-order-service`** was applied at `2026-10-23T22:36:18Z` in the `pets` namespace.
